mapper.sql: COALESCE( (SELECT NULLIF(R.NICKNAME, '') FROM T_RELATIONSHIP R JOIN T_CLASS C ON C.KINDERGARTEN_ID = R.KINDERGARTEN_ID WHERE C.ID = S.CLASS_ID AND R.USER_ID = S.AUTHOR), (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = S.AUTHOR) ) AUTHOR_NAME
mapper.select:
SELECT S.ID, S.CLASS_ID, S.DATE, S.TITLE, S.CONTENT, S.AUTHOR, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(S.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(S.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT,
FROM T_SUPPLY S WHERE S.CLASS_ID = #{classId} ORDER BY S.ID DESC

SELECT S.ID, S.CLASS_ID, S.DATE, S.TITLE, S.CONTENT, S.AUTHOR, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(S.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(S.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT,
FROM T_SUPPLY S WHERE S.ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_SUPPLY(CLASS_ID, DATE, TITLE, CONTENT, AUTHOR) VALUES (#{classId}, #{date}, #{title}, #{content}, #{author})
